definitions.gloss: to stretch around; to set up all around; to surround with
definitions.explanation: to extend or stretch something (like wire, rope, or barriers) around an area

definitions.gloss: to spread (a network); to establish (connections) throughout
definitions.explanation: used figuratively for networks, surveillance, information systems, or relationships that extend throughout an area

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{周|まわ}りに{柵|さく}を{張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らした。
examples.english: I put up a fence around the garden.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}に{警備|けいび}を{張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らせた。
examples.english: Security was set up throughout the venue.

examples.japanese: クモが{巣|す}を{張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らしている。
examples.english: A spider has spread its web all around.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}に{販売|はんばい}ネットワークを{張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らしている。
examples.english: They have spread a sales network throughout the country.

examples.japanese: {情報網|じょうほうもう}を{張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らせる。
{神経|しんけい}が{体中|からだじゅう}に{張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らされている。
examples.english: Nerves are spread throughout the body.

notes:
FORMS:
{張|は}る (to stretch, to put up) + {巡|めぐ}らす (to cause to go around) → to stretch all around

Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし})
- {張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らす → {張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らさない → {張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らして → {張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らした

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし})
Passive form {張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らされる is common

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {網|あみ}/ネット (net/network)
- {柵|さく}/{塀|へい} (fence/wall)
- {警備|けいび} (security)
- {監視|かんし} (surveillance)
- {神経|しんけい} (nerves)
- {血管|けっかん} (blood vessels)

USAGE:
Implies thorough, comprehensive coverage of an area or system. Often used for protective measures or organizational infrastructure.
